passages.title: The Big Dinosaur
passages.text:
Tim likes dinosaurs. He has many dinosaur books at home. Today, his class goes to a museum. Tim sees a very big dinosaur there. It is long and tall. 'It is a T-Rex!' says Tim. The T-Rex has big teeth and small arms. Tim's friend Sam is a little scared. 'It is not real,' says Tim. 'It is just bones.' The teacher tells the class about dinosaurs.

Tim draws the T-Rex in his notebook. At home, he shows the picture to Mum. 'Great job!' says Mum. Tim is very happy.

questions.q: Where does Tim's class go today?
questions.explanation: 短文第三句说，Tim 的班级今天去博物馆（museum），答对啦！

questions.q: What does the T-Rex have?
questions.explanation: 文中写到 T-Rex 有大大的牙齿和小小的手臂，你找得真准！

questions.q: What does Tim draw in his notebook?
questions.explanation: 第二段开头说 Tim 在笔记本上画了那只 T-Rex，真棒！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: Tim sees dinosaurs at a museum
questions.explanation: 整篇短文讲的是 Tim 班级去博物馆看恐龙的一天，主旨抓得很好！

questions.q: What does 'bones' mean in the story?
options: Hard white parts inside the body
questions.explanation: bones 是骨头的意思，博物馆里的恐龙只剩骨头啦，猜对了！

passages.title: Rocket to the Moon
passages.text:
Leo loves space. He has a toy rocket. It is red and white. At night, Leo looks at the stars. 'I want to go to the moon,' he says. Dad reads him a book about rockets. Rockets are very fast. They go up, up, up into the sky. Astronauts sit in the rocket. They wear special suits.

Leo makes a rocket with paper. He counts, 'Three, two, one, go!' The paper rocket flies across the room. Leo laughs and says, 'One day, I will fly a real rocket!'

questions.q: What color is Leo's toy rocket?
questions.explanation: 短文开头说 Leo 的玩具火箭是红白相间的，没错！

questions.q: Who reads Leo a book about rockets?
questions.explanation: 是爸爸给 Leo 读关于火箭的书，细节记得真牢！

questions.q: What does Leo make with paper?
questions.explanation: 第二段说 Leo 用纸做了一个火箭，还倒数发射呢，真有趣！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
questions.explanation: 整篇都在讲 Leo 对太空和火箭的热爱，主旨答对了！

questions.q: What does 'astronauts' mean?
questions.explanation: astronauts 就是宇航员，坐火箭飞上太空的人，你猜对啦！

passages.title: My Robot Friend
passages.text:
Ben gets a robot for his birthday. The robot is small and blue. Its name is Robo. Robo can walk and talk. 'Hello, Ben!' says Robo. Ben is very happy. Robo can sing songs too. It sings with Ben at breakfast. Robo also helps Ben find his socks. 'Thank you, Robo!' says Ben.

At night, Ben puts Robo on the desk. 'Good night, Robo,' says Ben. Robo's eyes go dark. Ben smiles. He has a new best friend.

questions.q: What color is Robo?
questions.explanation: 短文第二句说机器人 Robo 是蓝色的，答对啦！

questions.q: What does Robo help Ben find?
questions.explanation: Robo 帮 Ben 找到了袜子，真是个好帮手！

questions.q: Where does Ben put Robo at night?
questions.explanation: 晚上 Ben 把 Robo 放在书桌（desk）上，细节全对！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
questions.explanation: 短文讲的是 Ben 的新机器人朋友 Robo，主旨抓得准！

questions.q: 'Robo's eyes go dark.' What does 'dark' mean here?
questions.explanation: go dark 是灯光熄灭、变暗的意思，Robo 要睡觉啦，猜得好！

passages.title: The Soccer Cup
passages.text:
It is Saturday morning. Max plays soccer with his team. The game is in the park. Max runs fast with the ball. A boy from the other team runs after him. Max kicks the ball. Goal! His friends jump and shout. In the second half, Max kicks one more goal. His team wins two to one.

After the game, the coach gives Max a small cup. 'You played very well,' says the coach. Max is tired but happy. He loves soccer very much.

questions.q: Where is the soccer game?
questions.explanation: 短文第三句说比赛在公园里进行，没错！

questions.q: How many goals does Max kick?
questions.explanation: Max 先进一球，下半场又进一球，一共两球，数得真清楚！

questions.q: What does the coach give Max?
questions.explanation: 教练给了 Max 一个小奖杯（cup），奖励他踢得好！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: Max's team wins a soccer game
questions.explanation: 整篇讲的是 Max 和球队赢得足球比赛的故事，主旨答对啦！

questions.q: What does 'coach' mean?
options: A person who trains a team
A person who drives a bus
questions.explanation: coach 是教练，教球队训练的人，你猜对了！

passages.title: A New Pet
passages.text:
Kim wants a pet. She cannot have a dog because their home is small. Dad has an idea. They go to the pet shop. Kim sees fish, birds and cats. Then she sees a little hamster. It is brown and white. It runs in a wheel. 'I want this one!' says Kim.

The hamster's name is Nuts. Nuts likes to eat seeds. He sleeps in the day and runs at night. Kim cleans his home every week. Nuts is small, but he makes Kim very happy.

questions.q: Why can't Kim have a dog?
questions.explanation: 短文第二句说，因为他们家很小，所以不能养狗，答对啦！

questions.q: What pet does Kim get?
questions.explanation: Kim 最后选了一只棕白相间的小仓鼠，选得真好！

questions.q: When does Nuts run?
questions.explanation: Nuts 白天睡觉，晚上才跑步，仓鼠就是这样哦！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: Kim gets a new pet hamster
questions.explanation: 短文讲的是 Kim 得到新宠物仓鼠 Nuts 的故事，主旨完全正确！

questions.q: What does 'wheel' mean in the story?
questions.explanation: wheel 是会转动的轮子，仓鼠在轮子里跑步，猜对啦！

passages.title: Under the Sea
passages.text:
The sea is full of animals. Fish swim in big groups. They are red, yellow and blue. A turtle swims slowly. It is very old. Crabs walk on the sand. They have big claws. Look! A dolphin jumps out of the water. Dolphins are smart and friendly. They like to play.

But some animals are dangerous. A shark has sharp teeth. Jellyfish can sting. The sea is beautiful, but we must be careful. We should keep the sea clean, so the animals can live well.

questions.q: Which animal swims slowly?
questions.explanation: 文中说乌龟（turtle）游得很慢，而且年纪很大，答对了！

questions.q: What do dolphins like to do?
questions.explanation: 海豚聪明又友好，还喜欢玩耍，你找得真准！

questions.q: What animal has sharp teeth?
questions.explanation: 鲨鱼（shark）有锋利的牙齿，要小心哦！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: Sea animals and keeping the sea clean
How to swim in the sea
questions.explanation: 短文介绍了海洋动物，还告诉我们要保持大海干净，主旨抓得很好！

questions.q: 'Jellyfish can sting.' What does 'sting' mean?
questions.explanation: sting 是蜇人、用毒刺伤的意思，水母可不能乱碰，猜对啦！

passages.title: Super Ants
passages.text:
Ants are very small, but they are super strong. An ant can carry things much bigger than its body. Look at this ant! It carries a big leaf. Ants live together in a big family. Some ants find food. Some ants look after the babies. They all work very hard.

Ants talk with their feelers. They say, 'Food is this way!' Then many ants come to help. One ant cannot carry a big cake. But one hundred ants can! Teamwork makes ants super.

questions.q: What does the ant carry in the story?
questions.explanation: 文中那只蚂蚁正背着一片大叶子，力气真大，答对啦！

questions.q: How do ants talk to each other?
questions.explanation: 蚂蚁用触角（feelers）互相传递消息，真神奇！

questions.q: How many ants can carry a big cake?
questions.explanation: 一只蚂蚁搬不动大蛋糕，但一百只蚂蚁就可以，团结力量大！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: Ants are small but strong and work together
How to find an ant home
questions.explanation: 短文告诉我们蚂蚁虽小却很强壮，还会团队合作，主旨答对了！

questions.q: What does 'teamwork' mean?
questions.explanation: teamwork 是团队合作的意思，大家一起做事就更厉害，猜得好！

passages.title: Captain Star
passages.text:
Captain Star is a superhero. He wears a red cape and blue boots. He can fly very high in the sky. He can run very fast too. Every day, he helps people in the city. Today, a little cat is in a tall tree. It cannot get down. The cat's owner is very sad.

Captain Star flies up, up, up. He takes the cat down safely. 'Thank you, Captain Star!' says the girl. Captain Star smiles. 'Helping people is my job,' he says. Then he flies away.

questions.q: What color is Captain Star's cape?
questions.explanation: Captain Star 披着红色披风、穿着蓝色靴子，答对啦！

questions.q: Where is the little cat?
questions.explanation: 小猫被困在高高的树上下不来了，真让人着急！

questions.q: What does Captain Star do every day?
questions.explanation: Captain Star 每天都在城市里帮助人们，超级英雄就是这样！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: A superhero helps a little cat
How to fly in the sky
questions.explanation: 短文讲的是超级英雄 Captain Star 救下小猫的故事，主旨完全正确！

questions.q: What does 'cape' mean?
options: A long cloth worn on the back
questions.explanation: cape 是披风，超级英雄最爱穿啦，猜对啦！

passages.title: The Funniest Day at School
passages.text:
Today is Funny Hat Day at school. Everyone must wear a funny hat. Tom wears a hat with a toy duck on it. His best friend Jack wears a pizza hat. It looks like a real pizza! The teachers wear funny hats too. Miss Lee has a big flower hat with long green leaves.

At lunch, the class has a hat show. Everyone walks and shows their hats. The class laughs and claps. Tom's duck hat wins first prize! The prize is a box of colored pencils. 'This is the best day at school,' says Tom. When he gets home, he puts a photo of his duck hat on the wall. He will remember this funny day for a long time.

questions.q: What is on Tom's hat?
questions.explanation: Tom 的帽子上有一只玩具鸭子，还得了第一名呢！

questions.q: What does Jack's hat look like?
questions.explanation: Jack 的帽子看起来像真的披萨，太有创意了！

questions.q: What is the first prize?
questions.explanation: 第一名的奖品是一盒彩色铅笔，Tom 真厉害！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: A funny hat day at school
questions.explanation: 整篇讲的是学校滑稽帽子日的趣事，主旨答对啦！

questions.q: What does 'prize' mean?
options: Something you get when you win
questions.explanation: prize 是奖品，赢了比赛就能得到，猜得真好！

passages.title: Camping with Dad
passages.text:
Last weekend, Sam went camping with his dad. They drove to a lake in the mountains. First, they put up a tent. Sam helped with the poles. Then they made a fire and cooked sausages. The sausages were delicious. At night, they sat by the fire and looked at the stars. Sam saw a shooting star! 'Make a wish,' said Dad. Sam closed his eyes and made a wish.

In the morning, birds sang loudly. Sam and Dad went fishing by the lake. Sam caught one small fish. They let it go back into the lake. It was a great weekend, and Sam wants to go camping again soon.

questions.q: Where did Sam and Dad go camping?
options: Near a lake in the mountains
questions.explanation: 他们开车去了山里的一个湖边露营，答对啦！

questions.q: What did they cook on the fire?
questions.explanation: 他们在火上烤了香肠，美味极了！

questions.q: What did Sam see in the sky at night?
questions.explanation: Sam 看到了一颗流星，还许了愿呢，真幸运！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: Sam's camping trip with his dad
A day at the lake school
questions.explanation: 短文讲的是 Sam 和爸爸愉快的露营周末，主旨抓得准！

questions.q: 'Make a wish.' What does 'wish' mean?
questions.explanation: wish 是愿望，看到流星时许个愿吧，猜对啦！

passages.title: Pizza Day
passages.text:
Every Friday, Milo's family makes pizza at home. It is their favorite day of the week. Mum makes the dough. Milo puts tomato sauce on it. His sister Amy puts on cheese. Dad cuts the peppers and mushrooms. Milo loves cheese, so he always puts on a lot!

Then they put the pizza in the oven. The kitchen smells so good. After twenty minutes, the pizza is ready. It is hot and crispy. The family eats at the table together. Milo eats three big pieces. 'Your pizza is the best,' says Dad. Milo smiles. Making pizza is fun, and eating it is even better.

questions.q: When does Milo's family make pizza?
questions.explanation: 每周五是 Milo 家的披萨日，记住啦，答对啦！

questions.q: Who cuts the peppers and mushrooms?
questions.explanation: 爸爸负责切彩椒和蘑菇，一家人分工合作！

questions.q: How many pieces does Milo eat?
questions.explanation: Milo 吃了三大块披萨，胃口真好！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
questions.explanation: 短文讲的是一家人每周五一起做披萨的快乐时光，主旨完全正确！

questions.q: 'The pizza is hot and crispy.' What does 'crispy' mean?
questions.explanation: crispy 是酥脆的意思，刚烤好的披萨边脆脆的，猜对啦！

passages.title: The Big Snow
passages.text:
Yesterday, it snowed all night. In the morning, everything outside was white. School was closed! Dan was so happy. He put on his coat, hat and gloves. He ran outside with his sister. They made a big snowman in the garden. It had two black eyes and a long carrot nose.

Then they had a snowball fight with their friends. Dan threw a snowball, and it hit his friend right on the head! Everyone laughed loudly. After that, Mum made hot chocolate for the children. Dan's hands were cold, but the chocolate was warm and sweet. Dan hopes it will snow again very soon.

questions.q: Why was Dan so happy in the morning?
questions.explanation: 下了一夜大雪，学校停课了，所以 Dan 特别开心！

questions.q: What was the snowman's nose?
questions.explanation: 雪人有一个长长的胡萝卜鼻子，真可爱！

questions.q: What did Mum make for the children?
questions.explanation: 妈妈做了热巧克力，又暖和又甜，答对啦！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: Dan's fun day in the snow
questions.explanation: 短文讲的是 Dan 在雪天里玩耍的快乐一天，主旨抓得很好！

questions.q: 'Dan threw a snowball.' What does 'threw' mean?
options: Sent through the air by hand
questions.explanation: threw 是 throw（扔、抛）的过去式，Dan 扔出雪球打中了朋友，猜对啦！

passages.title: Jack's Birthday Surprise
passages.text:
Today is Jack's birthday. He is nine years old. When he comes home from school, the house is very quiet. 'Where is everyone?' Jack says. He opens the door slowly. 'Surprise!' Everyone jumps out from behind the sofa. His friends are all here! There are colorful balloons and a big cake on the table.

The cake is blue, Jack's favorite color. It has nine candles on it. Jack blows out the candles and makes a wish. Then they play games and eat cake together. Jack gets many nice presents. The best present is a football from Dad. 'This is the best birthday ever!' says Jack with a big smile.

questions.q: How old is Jack today?
questions.explanation: Jack 今天九岁了，蛋糕上正好有九根蜡烛！

questions.q: What color is the birthday cake?
questions.explanation: 蛋糕是蓝色的，那是 Jack 最喜欢的颜色！

questions.q: What is the best present for Jack?
questions.explanation: 最棒的礼物是爸爸送的足球，Jack 一定特别喜欢！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
questions.explanation: 短文讲的是大家为 Jack 准备的惊喜生日派对，主旨答对啦！

questions.q: What does 'candles' mean?
options: Small sticks of wax that burn
questions.explanation: candles 是蜡烛，生日蛋糕上点蜡烛许愿是我们的传统，猜得好！

passages.title: A Trip to the Beach
passages.text:
Last summer, Amy went to the beach with her family. They stayed in a small hotel near the sea. Every morning, Amy swam in the blue water. The waves were big and fun. Her brother collected shells on the sand. He even found a pink one!

One day, they took a boat trip. They saw dolphins jumping near the boat. Amy took many photos of them. In the evening, the family ate fish and chips by the sea. The sun went down slowly, and the sky turned orange and pink. It was beautiful. Amy loved the beach very much. She wants to go back there next summer.

questions.q: Where did Amy's family stay?
options: In a small hotel near the sea
questions.explanation: 他们住在海边的一家小旅馆，离大海很近！

questions.q: What did Amy's brother collect?
questions.explanation: 弟弟在沙滩上捡贝壳，还找到了一个粉色的，真幸运！

questions.q: What animals did they see on the boat trip?
questions.explanation: 坐船时他们看到海豚在船边跳跃，Amy 拍了好多照片！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
options: Amy's family trip to the beach
How to swim in the sea
A boat trip to an island
questions.explanation: 短文讲的是 Amy 一家人美好的海边之旅，主旨完全正确！

questions.q: 'The waves were big and fun.' What does 'waves' mean?
questions.explanation: waves 是海浪，一波一波的海水冲上岸，猜对啦！

passages.title: Game Night
passages.text:
Friday is game night at Chen's home. After dinner, the family plays games together in the living room. Chen likes board games best. Tonight, they play a racing game. Dad's car is red, and Chen's car is green. Chen rolls the dice. Six! His little green car goes very fast on the board.

Mum plays a card game with Chen's little sister, because she is too small for the racing game. Later, Chen wins the race! 'Good game!' says Dad with a smile. Then they all laugh and eat cookies together. Game night is not just about winning. It is about having fun with the family. Chen hopes every night could be game night.

questions.q: When is game night at Chen's home?
questions.explanation: 每周五晚上是 Chen 家的游戏之夜，答对啦！

questions.q: What color is Chen's car in the racing game?
questions.explanation: 爸爸的车是红色的，Chen 的车是绿色的，别记混哦！

questions.q: Who wins the race?
questions.explanation: Chen 掷出六点，小车跑得飞快，最后赢了比赛！

questions.q: What is the story mainly about?
questions.explanation: 短文讲的是 Chen 一家快乐的家庭游戏之夜，主旨抓得很好！

questions.q: What does 'dice' mean?
options: A small cube with dots or numbers
questions.explanation: dice 是骰子，掷出六点就能走六步，猜对啦！
